atoms.sound: John and Laura want to share a pie. Before they cut the pie, the pie is what?
atoms.b: John and Laura want to share a pie. Before they cut the pie, the pie is ((++whole --divided)).

atoms.sound: They both get an equal part if they divide the pie into how many halves?
atoms.b: They both get an equal part if they divide the pie into ((++two --three)) halves.

atoms.text: Now Ali and Patty join them. They want some of the pie too! John and Laura want to share their pieces so that everyone gets an equal piece.

instruction.text: Select the picture that shows how the four friends could share the pie.

correct.text: They cut their halves in half, so everyone gets a quarter.
